title: The period-function monotonicity and endpoint-limit conjecture for $G_\alpha$
statement:
Let $P(\beta)$ be the period function in $G_\alpha$, with $\beta$ the parameter used to specify the initial tangent vector. **The period-function conjecture.**

$$
\frac{d}{d\beta}P(\beta)<0
$$

and

$$
\lim_{\beta\to1}P(\beta)=\frac{\pi\sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{\alpha}}.
$$

The source establishes the corresponding monotonicity and endpoint limits for $\alpha=1$ and $\alpha=1/2$, while numerical computations support the proposed formula more generally. If true, the conjecture would give quantitative information about how the cut-locus behavior changes across the family.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.06430

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2020).
source_name: Matei P. Coiculescu, “An Interpolation from Sol to Hyperbolic Space”, arXiv:2005.06430 (2021).
